note: Copy this file to relay-settings.json and change the values. projects_dir: the folder with your code repositories. worktrees_dir (optional): where workers work; without it, <projects_dir>\_worktrees\claude. owner_name (optional): your name for the relay's notes. worker_tools (optional): the AI tools that may run workers, from claude, codex, gemini and antigravity; without it, only claude. Codex, Gemini and Antigravity workers stay off until you add them. Gemini costs money for every run. Google's consumer terms may not allow running Antigravity CLI from other programs, and your Google account could be suspended: read the relay README's part on Antigravity workers before you add antigravity. claude_exe, codex_exe, gemini_exe and antigravity_exe (optional): the full paths of those programs; without them, Claude Code's usual place, codex or gemini from your PATH, and %LOCALAPPDATA%\agy\bin\agy.exe or agy from your PATH. codex_exe is for the Codex wake too. antigravity_sandbox (optional, false unless you set it): true runs an Antigravity worker's commands in Antigravity CLI's terminal sandbox (--sandbox). Only for the Codex wake (bridge-relay.ps1 -EnrollCodex): codex_exec_args (optional) is a list of extra codex exec options, one per entry, such as ["--sandbox", "workspace-write"].
